name: ams-OSRAM AG
summary: ams-OSRAM AG engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of LED and optical sensor solutions in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the United States, and the Asia/Pacific. The company operates through Opto Semiconductors (OS); CMOS Sensors & ASICs (CSA); and Lamps & Systems (L&S) segments. It offers white, color, UV-C, IR, and multi color LEDs, as well as LED modules and accessories; color and IR lasers; photodiodes and phototransistors; optical modules; and automotive and digital systems and lamps, as well as power management ICs, LED driver and analog frontend ICs, and sensor interfaces.
